items.title: Why Government Bond Yields Are Rising and Causing Alarm
items.original_title: Why Government Bond Yields Are Rising and Causing Alarm
items.rss_summary: Government borrowing costs have been surging around the world as investors demand more compensation to entice them to hold longer-maturity debt. Yields on 30-year Japanese government bonds are near all-time highs at 4.19%, while 30-year UK government bond yields are at their highest since 1998. A Bloomberg gauge tracking government debt across the Group of Seven countries now yields its highest on average since September 2000.

items.rss_summary: Sept 1 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that the latest U.S. attack on Iran was "justified," and threatened bigger strikes if Tehran retaliated.Trump, in a Truth Social post, said the U.S. military was striking Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday in retaliation for Iran's "failed attempt at adding sea mines" to the Strait and for shooting eight missiles at a U.S. military base in Jordan. items.title: China's Xi lands in Egypt as Iran war reshapes Middle East alliances
items.original_title: China's Xi lands in Egypt as Iran war reshapes Middle East alliances
items.rss_summary: CAIRO, Sept 1 (Reuters) - Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt on Tuesday, his first visit to the Arab world's most populous nation in a decade, as countries across the Middle East reassess security and economic ties amid the fallout of the Iran war.The conflict has disrupted global energy markets and raised questions about whether regional countries can count on the United States as a long-term security partner.
